title: MusicFlow v5.2.1
releaseNotes: Pages and pivots slide in on every visit (Windows 8 transition)
iPhone: a one-time hint explains that only an installed app (Share, Add to Home Screen) fills the screen without Safari's bars
YouTube-only tracks are tagged in playlists and skipped with a short message (YouTube blocks playback outside its app)
Xbox Music look (Windows 8.1): black canvas, Xbox green, big lowercase titles, flat square tiles, panorama page header on the phone
Left pane with search, your playlists and the now-playing tile; pages are Collection, Radio, Explore, Browse, Search
Home shows a now-playing tile and a featured tile; the player bar is a Windows Phone app bar with circle buttons
Now Playing on wide screens: artwork and controls on the left, Up Next / Lyrics / Related on the right
No more flicker on Home; YouTube tracks are matched to the catalog only when title, version and artist or length agree
signingNote: Versions 2.7.3 and older were signed with a different key: uninstall them before installing 5.0.0.

ios.note: Sideload only. On iPhone, open the site itself in Safari and Add to Home Screen.
